description: This file provides helper functions for real-time updates of notes data from a Supabase backend. It includes functions to subscribe to database changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'public.notes' table and a utility to map database rows to application state shape.

methods.name: subscribeNotesChanges({ onInsert, onUpdate, onDelete } = {})
methods.description: Sets up a real-time subscription to changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the 'public.notes' table and calls provided callbacks when such changes occur. Returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: mapRowToNote(row)
methods.description: Converts a database row object into the application's note object format, mapping field names and formats appropriately.
